name: Phone P-009 R-44 export privacy allowlist mutation guard, re-run at the D-022 source
command: scripts/mutation-probe.sh --file "$PHONE_APP_ROOT/packages/data/src/postgres-store.ts" --relocation overlay --mutate 's/callContentExport\(toCall\(row\), row.segments, row.voicemail\)/({ format: "papercusp-phone-call-v1", call: toCall(row), segments: row.segments, voicemail: row.voicemail })/' --test "cd $PHONE_APP_ROOT/packages/data && npx vitest run src/call-export.integration.test.ts"
summary: 1/1 copy-out overlay mutant CAUGHT. The registered export integration suite passed against the canonical and the relocated canonical snapshot (9/9 each), then a PostgreSQL export mutant that returns the persisted call without its privacy allowlist (callContentExport bypassed) failed the intended assertion (1 failed | 8 passed: 'call export (postgres) > exports ordered content and read state without private media or conversation authority'). Re-runs the 2026-10-02 probe (docs/evidence/phone-p009-export-mutation-2026-10-02.json) at phone-app subject commit f23379183d7457d050541d1ae92c0d05554f3cf1 because the D-022 change re-fingerprinted postgres-store.ts. Software falsifiability only; no public PSTN or shipment claim.

assertions.evidence: packages/data/src/postgres-store.ts export allowlist bypassed: baseline 9/9, copy 9/9, mutant 1 failed | 8 passed

subjectRepository: phone-app harness repository (~/.papercusp-workspaces/papercusp-workspace/.papercusp/apps/phone-app); probes[].subject/tests are relative to that root.
method: papercusp scripts/mutation-probe.sh copy-out --relocation overlay (mutant bound over the real path in a private mount namespace; shared tree never mutated; tree integrity verified byte-identical afterwards), phone-app's own Vitest.
scope: Falsifiability of the R-44 export privacy allowlist on the production PostgreSQL store.

probes.name: export
probes.subject: packages/data/src/postgres-store.ts
probes.mutation: callContentExport(toCall(row), row.segments, row.voicemail) replaced by a raw object carrying the full persisted call (private recordingUri and conversation authority leak into the export)
